title: Soft-wrap column mode and hierarchical sort affordance for virtualized tables
creator: Ava Patel
description: Introduce a 'soft-wrap' column rendering mode and a hierarchical sorting affordance to improve readability and sorting power in large virtualized tables. Soft-wrap mode should allow cells to wrap longer content without changing virtualization measurement heuristics excessively; hierarchical sorting affordance permits multi-level sort controls (primary/secondary) exposed inline in column headers. This ticket covers design exploration, accessibility review, tokens/spacing adjustments, and handoff artifacts for implementation.
background: Current virtualized table modes prioritize single-line truncation to preserve predictable row heights and batch measurements. Customers frequently ask for readable rows that show wrapped content for comment-like columns, and PMs want more discoverable multi-column sort controls for analytics use-cases. Previous tickets focused on density and resize gestures but left multiline content and hierarchical sort UX under-specified.
goals: Design a soft-wrap rendering mode that preserves virtualization performance and predictable row height when toggled
Define header affordance for hierarchical sort (primary/secondary/toggle clear) that works across density modes
Update token recommendations for vertical rhythm when wrapping is enabled
Produce accessibility spec (keyboard, screen reader, focus order)
Create developer-ready handoff with props/variants and visible examples in Storybook
constraints: Virtualization engine requires predictable average row height for effective windowing
Avoid adding heavy DOM measurement during scroll
Header affordance must fit compact density without truncating title labels
Must work with existing column-resize and sticky-column behaviors
proposed_solutions: Introduce a per-column 'wrapMode' prop: off | soft | force; soft allows wrap but uses a capped height and 'show more' overlay for overflow
Implement CSS layering: line-clamp fallback for browsers without efficient measurement; measure only on column toggle events, not per-scroll
Header affordance: two-level click region — primary click sorts asc/desc, chevron menu opens small popover listing secondary sort options + clear
Provide density-aware token variants: spacing-small/medium/large that adjust max-lines and 'show more' threshold
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates no >10% throughput regression in table render benchmarks with soft-wrap enabled on a 10k-row dataset
Keyboard navigation: users can tab to header, activate primary/secondary sort without mouse, and announce sorting order to screen reader
Design tokens updated and documented; Storybook shows Compact/Default/Spacious with wrap mode examples
Engineering PR includes unit tests for header affordance and an integration test for virtualization measurements
engineer_notes: Need ENG to expose a per-column measurement hook to cap row height during soft-wrap
Consider KV cache implications for rendering thresholds; coordinate with ENG-6391
next_steps: Usability micro-test with 3 internal users — schedule by 2026-03-18
Developer API proposal draft and sync with ENG — 2026-03-20
